## Orientation

Wave partner is fix-orchestra-help-tests, which writes only in ~/orchestra. You write only in /home/andrewyin/affidavit--standalone-aff on branch phase/standalone-aff. Edit tests/test_standalone_cli.py only. Do not edit ~/orchestra, the CLI, or .artifacts. Do not call adaptive-artifacts.

Name the test so pytest -k verdict_help selects it. Commit excluding .artifacts with message fix-verdict-help-test.

R1: bin/aff accepts verdict and rejects check and close-batch. A checkout of this repo, with no orchestra tree, no adaptive-artifacts on PATH, and no se-workflow store binding, still produces a verdict from the committed manifest.

aff-orchestra-seam: aff is verdict-only; orchestra check and orchestra close-batch own the store client; orchestra imports affidavit.oracle_red and does not import run_verdict.
record.subject: fix-verdict-help-test
